slides: Your muscles remember more than reps.
Each contraction writes a neural pattern.
That pattern dictates future movement efficiency.
Reinforce it with consistent load, not occasional max.
Consistency builds strength that never forgets.
Procrastination is a budget of future regret.
Every delayed task adds interest to that debt.
Interest compounds faster than any deadline.
Pay it off now, and the balance shrinks instantly.
Act now; you save tomorrow’s remorse.
Energy isn’t found, it’s engineered.
Sleep restores mitochondria, the cell’s power plant.
Protein fuels repair, carbs refill the battery.
Movement cycles the charge, preventing drain.
Design your day to recharge, not deplete.
Alignment isn’t posture, it’s purpose.
When goals match daily actions, friction drops.
Low friction means less willpower needed.
Your habits become the path of least resistance.
Set clear intent, and momentum follows.
